source_binding.semantics_used: wasDerivedFrom records derivation lineage between entities; wasInvalidatedBy records invalidation separately from derivation history; derivation may be made explicit through usage/activity/generation.

source_binding.source: Doyle, Truth Maintenance Systems for Problem Solving (IJCAI 1977)
source_binding.semantics_used: record logical justifications for beliefs, update incrementally when hypotheses are retracted or new information is discovered, and identify supporting assumptions.
normal prerequisites encode dependency relevant to out-of-date propagation, while order-only prerequisites impose ordering without invalidating a target when they change.

rules: Keep historical evidence and terminal records immutable.
Represent a later underdeclared-dependency discovery as a new append-only taint diagnostic on the affected evidence identity.
For each derived transition, retain the predeclared set of sufficient justification sets. A justification remains valid iff every evidence identity in that set is currently eligible.
A transition remains current-credit eligible iff at least one sufficient justification set remains valid; otherwise quarantine only its current credit identity.
Propagate taint only along declared justification edges; do not traverse unrelated history.
A stale or duplicate completion cannot clear a taint. Requalification requires a distinct current-scope repaired evidence identity with its own terminal readback.
Transport/CAS/readback failure is non-semantic: keep the last durably read-back qualification graph authoritative.

taint_diagnostic.reason: later finding: E1 depended on changed task_data and was wrongly reused

candidate_results.reason: deletes historical evidence and indiscriminately rolls back later transitions

scope: constructed role-local fixed justification graph only; this is controller-mechanism conformance evidence, not a benchmark of W3C PROV, GNU make, Doyle TMS, or a general claim that all underdeclared dependencies are discoverable.

phase1_acceptance.repository_api_use: lightweight state/evidence transport only; no API volume used as compute

exact_next_action: Read this terminal artifact back by path. Only after exact readback, advance controller credit by one and select a distinct non-conflicting Phase-1 switching/recovery leaf; precommit its guards before reading that leaf's public mechanism semantics.
